note: Set A captures the full Table 4-1 material set (steel E, G, density plus soil shear modulus 140E6 Pa and Poisson's ratio 0.4) and correctly binds the 0.170 Hz value to the tower-monopile mode, while Set B omits the soil properties entirely and misattributes the 0.170 Hz coupled mode to the monopile alone. Set B does win one point by recording the 100 t transition piece mass and the correct 3P band (0.25–0.5 Hz from Figure 4-1), which Set A misses or states as 0.25–0.38 Hz. Both sets contain the same spurious 0.18 Hz tower frequency and a 0.25–0.38 Hz 3P range, but Set B adds two further misbound claims (monopile mode, 'East Coast site generic frequency range'), and Set A's only extra defect is an invented 'steady-state' condition. Overall Set A has fewer wrong claims and more unique correct facts.
